color.note: Ink for action, colour for state. Neutrals carry a faint green-grey cast (vellum by day, graphite by night); the four hues below are reserved for meaning and never used as decoration.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels, the rail and the scope bar. Row hover inside tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: log bodies, code, the segmented-control track, key caps, idle badges.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating: menus, the command bar, sheets, toasts. Always paired with a shadow token.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, off-switch tracks. Holds 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token. Also the selected-tab rule and selection outlines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata, placeholders and inactive icons, on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only. Below 4.5:1 by design, so never for information.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and the on-state of switches. Ink, not a hue: one primary action per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill; the thumb of an on switch.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Work in flight: deploying, building, applying a plan, live streams. Also links, focus and text selection. As text, on any surface or cobalt-soft.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cobalt text: deploying pills, info callouts, the selected table row.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid cobalt fill.

tokens.name: healthy
tokens.usage: Healthy, succeeded, passing. Always with the filled-circle glyph and a word. As text, on any surface or healthy-soft.

tokens.name: healthy-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind healthy text: pills, success callouts, added lines in a plan.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded, nearing a limit, needs attention soon. Always with the triangle glyph and a word. As text, on any surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text: pills, warning callouts, changed values in a plan.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Down, failed, destructive. Always with the square glyph and a word. Fill of the danger button. As text, on any surface or critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind critical text: pills, error callouts, removed lines in a plan.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Label on the danger button and glyphs inside down tiles.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Stopped, paused, not scheduled. Always with the hollow-ring glyph. Alias of ink-muted.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Running with nothing checking it, so all that is known is that it runs. Always with the ring-and-dot glyph and a word. Never green, as no check passed, and never ink, which is for action. Alias of ink-muted.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Nobody can say: its agent isn't connected or can't read Docker, or the panel can't reach the control plane. Always with the dashed-ring-and-dash glyph and a word, never as not running. Alias of ink-muted.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Plus sign and new values in plans and diffs, on diff-add-soft.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind new values.

tokens.name: diff-change
tokens.usage: Tilde sign for in-place updates and replacements.

tokens.name: diff-change-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a changed resource's summary.

tokens.name: diff-remove
tokens.usage: Minus sign and old values in plans and diffs (old values are also struck through), on diff-remove-soft.

tokens.name: diff-remove-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind old values.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Underline on hover; never colour alone in body copy.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection and selected or focused table rows.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind sheets and the command bar.

families.sans: "Host Grotesk", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Host Grotesk for every human word. Its default figures are tabular, so live numbers never jitter. Sentence case everywhere; no all-caps labels.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and onboarding only. Never inside a working view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and section headings, sheet titles on narrow screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Revision 128 replaced 127 on 3 servers with no downtime.
styles.usage: Default text: descriptions, callouts, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis within body, list titles, toast titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs, table cells in compact density.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, metadata, timestamps, legends. Sentence case, ink-muted.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Live numbers in Metric. Pair with a unit in caption or body.

groups.name: Machine
groups.note: JetBrains Mono only for values a machine produced or will parse: IPs, hashes, image tags, paths, commands, logs, selectors. Never for UI labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline machine values, input values for paths and commands, resource names in plans.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Tags, table cells holding machine values, log lines.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Dense screens use space-2 to space-4 inside panels and space-6 between them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between fleet tiles; icon to tight label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside controls; gap between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in controls and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; top of onboarding screens.

radius.note: Radius grows with the size of the thing; nested corners stay concentric (outer = inner + padding).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Fleet tiles, tags, key caps, diff marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented items, command rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, callouts, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and the command bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, switches, avatars.

size.note: Fixed dimensions for controls and layout regions.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, toolbar controls, inline actions in tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Onboarding and empty-state buttons; touch layouts.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail on desktop.

tokens.name: scopebar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar holding the scope and command entry.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Default width of a side sheet (plans, settings).

shadow.note: Shadows only for things that float. Resting panels use a line border, never a shadow. Dark shadows add a faint light edge so layers stay separable.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and the command bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid cobalt (box-shadow, so it follows the radius). At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the scope bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Side sheets and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-command
tokens.usage: The command bar, above sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
